description: A physical location or place which is a subordinate location of a location.

locationFunctionTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of subordinate location.

physicalGeographicalCoordinate.description: Physical geographical coordinate information for this subordinate location.

subordinateSubordinateSubordinateLocatio.description: The location subordinate to this subordinate location.
